prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE production icon atlas for Elements - Icons. The supplied image is a STYLE REFERENCE; replace its subjects with the subjects specified here.
Rustic, earnest old-fashioned COLOURED WOODCUT. Match the supplied references' warm black, dull ochre, clay/rust red, slate blue, muted olive and creamy carved cuts, but visibly simpler and less polished than the first reference: a small number of broad confident cuts, occasional knife slips, uneven angular contours, slightly crooked handmade things, thin missed patches in ink and colour plates shifted slightly beyond or short of their black outlines. Imperfect registration must look printed, not blurred. No smooth gradients, modeled digital shading, tiny decorative hatching, glossy highlights, outline stickers, cute toy proportions, circular badges, frames or presentation shadows. Humble functional objects, easily recognised at 56 pixels. Natural, clear silhouettes before texture. Transparent outside each object.
EXACTLY FIVE columns and FOUR rows, 20 equal cells, wide 5:4 atlas. Keep every complete subject centered in its own cell with at least 15% TRANSPARENT MARGIN from all cell boundaries; strict grid with clear wide gutters. No labels or numbering, no drawn grid, no text except where explicitly requested. Do not repeat objects from the reference unless listed. Make the states of related objects clearly different, using silhouettes and visible contents.
READING ORDER:
1. Telescope: Long plain brass-and-wood refracting telescope angled upward, handheld, NO tripod
2. Glass slide: One small flat thin rectangular pale-blue glass slip seen obliquely, no liquid
3. Pond water: Shallow glazed bowl of slightly olive-blue water containing two small green specks and one reed beside it
4. Pond slide: Small rectangular pale-blue glass slide with one round blue-green drop centered on it
5. Illustrated flora: Open large book combining a pressed green plant on one page and a coloured botanical flower drawing on the other
6. Pressed plant specimen: One cream specimen sheet with a flattened branching olive plant held down by two small pale paper strips, no book
7. Herbarium: Open brown-bound book containing a pressed dry olive plant secured with paper strips, no coloured flower drawing
8. Leaf study: One enlarged simple olive leaf with pronounced branching veins beside a small round lens
9. Botanical drawing: Cream SHEET with a clearly drawn red flowering botanical specimen and small detached leaf study, no letters
10. Weather record: One cream sheet combining wind-direction strokes and three blue water-level bars beside a small cloud symbol
11. Clear collector with level marks: EMPTY transparent straight-sided glass collector with a cream vertical strip bearing five broad dark level ticks, no numbers
12. Weather book: Open brown-bound book showing a large wind symbol on one page and blue level bars on the other
13. Collected rain level: Same transparent marked glass collector now visibly one-third filled with slate-blue water
14. Windsock: Plain rust-red tapering cloth windsock extending from the top of a thin wooden mast, open mouth on left
15. Rain record: Cream paper sheet showing three broad blue water-level bars beneath a small rain cloud, no wind strokes
16. Wind record: Cream paper sheet showing three directional wind strokes beside a simple rust-red windsock drawing, no blue level bars
17. Smoked fish: Two brown smoked fish hanging from a short crossbar by thin ties, tails down, broad smoke-darkened cuts
18. Pickle jar: Transparent wide-necked glass jar filled with red and green fruit wedges in amber liquid, fitted wooden lid
19. Salt: Small low bright cream-white mound of angular salt crystals, no bowl or liquid
20. Net: Plain ochre fishing net with clearly open diamond mesh, two tied corner ropes
Keep all twenty separate, complete and rustic.
